text:
Samir: Quick question  whats the most ridiculous temporary Zoom backdrop youve used? mine today: laundry basket + beach towel draped over a lamp. worked surprisingly well. :laundry:
Tess: photos or it didnt happen :camera_with_flash:
Samir: https://example.com/laundry-backdrop.jpg  the towel kept flapping when the AC kicked on. felt very avant-garde. :dash:
Priya: brilliant. also, my ISP did a random flake-out during standup this morning. packet loss galore. anyone have a quick phone-tether trick?
Samir: if you have an Android, enable hotspot and set band to 5GHz for better stability. also kill background uploads.
Tess: for iPhone: use low-power mode off (weirdly helps), turn off automatic iCloud sync, then tether.
Priya: tried tether, but the laptop kept preferring the house Wi-Fi (old habits die hard). had to forget the network mid-call. awkward. :grimacing:
Samir: been there. set your home Wi-Fi to "Auto Reconnect: off" in Net preferences for a day until trouble passes.
infra-bot: Scheduled maintenance: ISP-Edge peering refresh on 2026-05-02 03:00 UTC. Expect short reconnects under 2 minutes in some regions.
Priya: perfect timing, as always. :roll_eyes:
Tess: pro backdrop hack: clip a king-size bedsheet to the back of a folding room divider with binder clips. anchor base with heavy books so kids dont knock it down.
Samir: this is gold. also, name that setup: Fortified Fort. marketing potential? :trophy:
Priya: adding to the WFH builder pack. also curious: anyone use a small USB Wi-Fi adapter as a backup? cheap and works in a pinch.
Tess: yes! Plug one in and force the OS to use it for calls. 10 bucks saved my sanity last month.
sticker-bot: :sparkles: added a sticker to Samir's photo
Samir: ok im assembling a "WFH emergency kit": binder clips, USB mic, cheap Wi-Fi adapter, duct tape, and a tiny whiteboard for kid cameo signups.
Priya: love the tiny whiteboard idea. our team now has "KID CAMO" on Wednesdays.
Tess: share a pic when ready. also, consider labeling cables. saved me from unplugging the wrong thing during a meltdown.
Samir: will do. if anyone wants the sheet+divider shopping link, Ill drop it here after lunch. 
Priya: thanks all. going to test the hotspot strategy before the 2pm sync. report back if it holds.
Samir: good luck. may your audio not sound like a submarine. :ocean:
Priya: fingers crossed.
